headline: Arkansas’ smoking ban just turned 20. Can the state find common ground on public health again?
summary: The Arkansas indoor smoking ban, enacted 20 years ago, was a bipartisan effort led by then-Governor Mike Huckabee, demonstrating that public health progress can be made through compromise and expert trust.

headline: El-Sayed, Warren court McMorrow supporters at Ferndale rally
summary: The article reports on a political rally for U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed in Ferndale, Michigan, featuring prominent speakers like Sen. Elizabeth Warren and Sen. Chris Van Hollen. The event is part of El-Sayed's campaign to highlight grassroots support and his opposition to corporate PAC money influencing elections. No protests or civil unrest were mentioned in the article.
